g.text: ESP32-S3 · 2 MOTORS · 4 SERVOS · LINE + ULTRASONIC · IMU
A classroom robot designed and built in Zambia. Drive, sensing
and building are all on one board. This cardboard chassis gets you
moving in an afternoon; later the same board drops into the
Two encoder motors, four servo ports, IMU
Add the arm module: two servos, gear-linked claw
Controller RoboCore V2, ESP32-S3, 68 x 60 mm
Power 1S Li-ion, 3 x 18650 in parallel, USB-C charging
Drive 2 x TT encoder motors, 56 mm wheels, 2 casters
Sensing 3-channel line sensor, HC-SR04 ultrasonic, IMU
Chassis 125 x 150 x 41 mm, 3 mm card
1 Cut the solid lines, score the folds.
2 Fold up the side walls, then the rear wall; glue its tabs.
3 Motors through the shaft holes, zip-tied; wheels on.
4 Battery holder in from the back; casters on.
5 Deck over, front flap down; glue its tabs.
6 Controller on the deck, leads up through the slots.
7 HC-SR04 behind the flap, line sensor under the nose.
Keep metal 15 mm from the antenna. Not for under 8s.
RoboCore V2 cardboard chassis, branded print, 1:1 on A3 (3 mm card). Solid navy = cut, grey dashed = fold (score, do not cut).
Check: the bar at the right must measure 100 mm.
